about_the_game:
This is a post apocalyptic survival game, where you must find ways to scavenge resources, strengthen your base, and survive.

Game features:

Survival - There will be regular waves of corpses attacking the base, and other survivor forces will be watching closely.

Search - Various material containers are waiting for your arrival

Combat - including zombies, human survivors, enemies, and certain special infectious agents

Forces - There are other survivor forces in the game, and you can choose to conquer them, collect taxes, and arrange missions

Construction - You can build rooms for different purposes in your underground base, such as a medical room, kitchen, etc

Members - You can recruit base members and assign tasks to them

Upgrade - Killing zombies or other tasks can accumulate experience points to upgrade and strengthen one's abilities

Finally, it should be noted that:

This game was independently completed by the author, and I poured my passion into it. Due to my own energy and ability limitations, there may be many shortcomings, please forgive me!

content_descriptors.notes: This game is a zombie eschatological survival game. Players can attack zombies or other eschatological survivors, and they will also be attacked. Therefore, there is some bloody violence, which may contain some terrorist elements.

name: Under the apocalypse
short_description: The apocalypse is coming, you need to search for supplies everywhere and build your underground base. Recruit members and assign tasks. Arm yourself to resist attacks from other survivors and hordes of corpses. You can also take the initiative to conquer other survivor forces and collect their taxes
